Priya Nair: Billing ticket — project X charged even though request proxied from project Y using delegated SA. origin shows proxy-service and we lose effective-owner.
Sam Whitaker: We normalize origin for safety which hides delegated identity.
Leo Gonzalez: Idea: add a signed effective-owner envelope so downstream systems can attribute correctly without trusting arbitrary headers.
Rohit Verma: Proto: X-Redwood-Effective-Owner: v1;sig=BASE64;payload=BASE64 (payload contains org,project,sa,iat). Verification key published by auth service.
Ava (Console PM): Console needs to show both Auth origin and Effective owner in the request inspector and in Billing -> Attribution. Prefer a read-only inspector initially.
Priya Nair: UX: compact pill with hover for full provenance, toggle to choose which field powers billing export.
Sam Whitaker: Quotas/throttles must still use immediate request identity. Billing/telemetry can use effective-owner.
metrics-bot: Estimate: adding effective_owner dimension raises cardinality ~18%; with HMAC-prefixing it drops to ~6%.
Leo Gonzalez: Migration: keep legacy series and add effective_owner_v2 series so dashboards don't flip.
Rohit Verma: Rollout plan: feature flag "effective-owner-header" for proxies; enable only for delegated SA flows; create signing keypair; verification in ingest; write effective_owner_* metrics.
Priya Nair: Fail criteria: signature verification errors >0.1% of delegated requests, billing mismatch >1%, ingestion spike >20% for 12h.
metrics-bot: Feature flag created by Rohit Verma; canary started us-west-2 @ 2026-03-22T09:04:40Z (10%).
Ava (Console PM): I'll prep the Console copy and canary ticket. Sync tomorrow to align ops + billing + console.
